in_sanskrit.name: अशिमा
in_sanskrit.meaning: Not easily agitated, not easily angered
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is not easily agitated, not easily angered, calm, peaceful, serene and composed.

in_hindi.name: अशिमा

in_tamil.name: அசிமா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is free from excessive agitation or anger, or the one who is peaceful and tranquil.

in_telugu.name: అశీమా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is not easily agitated, not easily angered, calm, peaceful, serene and composed.

in_marathi.name: Ashima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashima is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘asha’ which means hope and ‘ima’ which means mother. The name signifies the maturity and extended nature of a mother’s love and hope.
